Well, Pickle....I have to say..you should have used a stronger syntax going into this argument.

"Jfag please go kill yourself, oh please."

Kill is such an overused term, try something a little more exotic. the second oh please, it just kills the sentence. The contradiction between begging to have him kill himself, and saying please, it just makes the argument sound like you want him to live.... It should sound more like this.

"Jfag go execute yourself"

 Next sentence, come on...

"braincocksucker you'r just a gay son of a bitch"

Capitalize names, you should have learned this in first grade. You misspelled the word: you're. a comma should go after Braincocksucker, the dependent and independent clauses prove this. it should sound like this. Edit your work, and try again.

"Braincocksucker, you're just a gay son of a bitch"

I'd help correct you more, but I have to go now. One last thing, don't forget to Capitalize your I's.
